title: The Growth Kinetic and Ultra High Hardness of CoCrFeNiTi High–Entropy Alloy by Mechanical Alloying and Spark Plasma Sintering

recollection.starting_material: Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, Ti powders
recollection.intervention: Mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering
recollection.structure: High-entropy alloy with ultra high hardness

score.note: The recollection identifies the two processing methods and the general high-hardness HEA outcome, but only at the level given in the title. It omits milling/SPS conditions, FCC/BCC phase fractions, nanocrystalline grain size, strengthening mechanisms, and all numerical property results.
